mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bike_vehicle WHERE assemble_time >= CURRENT_DATE()) AS todayAssembled, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bike_vehicle WHERE status = 2) AS physicalInventory, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bike_vehicle v WHERE status=2 AND ) AS quarantinedInventory, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bike_stock_in_record WHERE operation_time >= CURRENT_DATE() AND status = 'COMPLETED') AS todayStockIn, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bike_stock_out_record WHERE operation_time >= CURRENT_DATE() AND status = 'COMPLETED') AS todayStockOut ,(SELECT COALESCE(SUM(qty),0) FROM () c) AS lockedInventory

SELECT CASE status WHEN 0 THEN '待组装' WHEN 1 THEN '组装完成' WHEN 2 THEN '已入库' WHEN 3 THEN '已出库' WHEN 4 THEN '返工中' WHEN 5 THEN '售后维修' WHEN 6 THEN '报废' ELSE '未知' END AS label, COUNT(*) AS count, CASE status WHEN 0 THEN '#94a3b8' WHEN 1 THEN '#1677c8' WHEN 2 THEN '#16a36a' WHEN 3 THEN '#8b5cf6' WHEN 4 THEN '#f59e0b' WHEN 5 THEN '#ef4444' ELSE '#64748b' END AS color FROM bike_vehicle GROUP BY status ORDER BY status

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(operation_time, '%H:%i:%s') AS time, action, COALESCE(frame_sn, business_id, '-') AS target, COALESCE(operator_name, '-') AS operator, '已记录' AS status FROM bike_operation_log WHERE 1=1 ORDER BY operation_time DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT event_date AS date, SUM(assembled) AS assembled, SUM(stock_in) AS stockIn, SUM(stock_out) AS stockOut FROM ( SELECT DATE_FORMAT(assemble_time, '%Y-%m-%d') event_date, 1 assembled, 0 stock_in, 0 stock_out FROM bike_vehicle WHERE assemble_time >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) UNION ALL SELECT DATE_FORMAT(operation_time, '%Y-%m-%d'), 0, 1, 0 FROM bike_stock_in_record WHERE status = 'COMPLETED' AND operation_time >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) UNION ALL SELECT DATE_FORMAT(operation_time, '%Y-%m-%d'), 0, 0, 1 FROM bike_stock_out_record WHERE status = 'COMPLETED' AND operation_time >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) ) events GROUP BY event_date ORDER BY event_date
